title: AP Chemistry Fixture Unit 1 Challenge Lab

items.title: Weighted isotope sample
items.prompt: A hypothetical element occurs as 10.0 amu atoms with 20.0% abundance and 11.0 amu atoms with 80.0% abundance. Calculate its average atomic mass.
items.answer_guide: Convert the percentages to fractions and calculate (10.0 × 0.200) + (11.0 × 0.800) = 10.8 amu.
items.story_hint: Use the weighted balance from the second scene.
items.success_criterion: Set up the weighted average correctly and report 10.8 amu.
